row.team_price_text: Price upon request (blocks of 50,000 orders per year)
row.evidence: SAP Commerce Cloud's editions are all "Price upon request", and SAP Help documents SCIM 2.0 Users and Groups APIs (cloudscimwebservices extension) for creating, reading, updating and disabling employees.
row.notes: Quote-only: every SAP Commerce Cloud edition (composable, premier, cloud ERP) is 'Price upon request', priced on annual orders or GMV rather than per user. SCIM covers Backoffice/ASM employees, not shoppers: the customer must add the cloudscimwebservices extension to manifest.json (context path /scim, Swagger at /scim/v3), and calls need an OAuth token with ROLE_SCIM_CLIENT. SAP's documented client is SAP Cloud Identity Services (Identity Authentication as source, Identity Provisioning job pushing employees and groups periodically); SSO to Backoffice/ASM uses Identity Authentication. No Okta OIN or Entra gallery app found for SAP Commerce Cloud.

scim.notes: The extension must be added to manifest.json; the generated server URL in SAP's OpenAPI sample ends in /scim/v3.

auth.token_source: OAuth client (client credentials) in SAP Commerce Cloud with authority ROLE_SCIM_CLIENT; token URL /authorizationserver/oauth/token

deprovision.notes: The extension supports disabling employees and also exposes DELETE /Users/{userId}; which one the Identity Provisioning job uses on removal is not stated.

filtering.notes: GET /Users and GET /Groups take filter, attributes, excludedAttributes, count, startIndex and startId parameters.

custom.how: ScimExtensions object for extended schema attributes specified by the resource type.

attributes.notes: Read from the ScimUser and ScimGroup schemas in SAP's OpenAPI specification on the help page.

roles.how: SCIM groups become ScimUserGroupModel entries; a Backoffice admin assigns Commerce user groups to them, so members get those authorizations.

limitations.text: Only available when the customer adds the cloudscimwebservices extension to manifest.json.
Users endpoint returns users of type Employee only (Backoffice/ASM staff, not customers).
On group creation only the group name is stored; members must already exist as users.

fallbacks.other_sync: SAP Cloud Identity Services: Identity Provisioning job periodically provisions Identity Authentication employees and groups into SAP Commerce Cloud.
